item.title: New Radar Delivery Pushes Arleigh Burke Destroyer Modernization Work Toward Next Phase
item.summary: The USS Pinckney is first in line to get the new AN/SPY‑6(V)4 radar, a key part of a larger upgrade package. The post New Radar Delivery Pushes Arleigh Burke Destroyer Modernization Work Toward Next Phase appeared first on TWZ .
